Authentic Arabic Flavors and Top-Notch Shisha in Saigon”
Apr 2025 • Friends
Bazaar Restaurant is a fantastic spot in Ho Chi Minh City for authentic Arabic cuisine and top-quality shisha. The food is full of flavor - especially the kebabs and hummus-and the shisha is smooth with lots of flavor options.
The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, with friendly staff and great service. A perfect place to unwind with friends or enjoy a chill evening. Highly recommend!

Middle Eastern Nights Done Right
Jan 2025 • Friends
That night felt like a slow dance in the desert. Warm lights, intricate tiles, oud music drifting through the air — and the food? Rich, bold, and full of soul. The lamb melted. The hummus whispered.

Shisha hit smooth — mint & lemon, clouding the night in soft smoke and soft laughs. Wine clinked. Time paused. A little luxury, a little escape.

10/10 would float back again.
